summary.decision_summary: In Purdytory won by 13.6. In Purdytory left 9.9 lineup points on the table, while Sigma Chi Whiteout left 9.0.
summary.historical_summary: In Purdytory is 18-24 against Sigma Chi Whiteout across 42 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor In Purdytory
summary.winner_reason: In Purdytory won by 13.6 after scoring +18.9 against projection. The leading starters were Patrick Mahomes (44.1) and Emmett Johnson (38.1).
summary.loser_reason: Sigma Chi Whiteout lost by 13.6 even while beating projection by 0.4 points. Sam LaPorta scored 2.6. A best legal lineup added 9.0, still short of the 13.6-point margin.
